company.name: Thyme Care
company.shortDescription: Thyme Care provides value-based oncology management services designed to coordinate care for individuals diagnosed with cancer.
company.description: Thyme Care provides value-based oncology management services designed to coordinate care for individuals diagnosed with cancer. The company pairs individuals with dedicated support teams composed of nurses and care partners who assist with appointment scheduling, symptom tracking, transportation logistics, and financial resources. Its platform integrates clinical analytics and navigation software directly into health plan systems and oncology practice workflows to identify patient needs early. By offering round-the-clock clinical guidance and resource coordination, the organization works alongside health plans, risk-bearing entities, and medical providers to improve health outcomes and reduce unnecessary medical expenditures.

insights.title: Funding is concentrated in the latest major round
insights.statement: The latest disclosed Series E round raised $125,000,000, or 31.33% of reported total funding.
insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $101,399,742 to $2,000,000,000, a 19.72x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.
